property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and a callee that can record properly-formed transferFrom(address,address,uint256) calls, the correct contract always invokes the callee with a successfully decoded transferFrom(from, to, v) once per recipient (so the recorder observes exactly one decoded triple and success), whereas the mutant uses the wrong selector/signature and therefore can fail to produce a successful decoded call for some inputs (the recorder will either see a failed call or different decode), violating that rule.
change_summary: Change selector data to call transferFrom(address,address,uint256) but with wrong order transferFrom(address,uint256,address) (i.e., use different signature) so call will likely fail and cause revert via require(_s).
